Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: when the new and old models differ in size, you need to replace the protective case.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, this seems quite likely to happen. However, two accessory manufacturers disagree, and one of them is firmly convinced of this...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, saying it is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely sure about this and added a comment saying, "It's too early." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad—whose company specialises in anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones—says his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Reports on the thickness of the iPhone Pro are contradictory

Last year, leakers indicated that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report did not mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier show that the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimetres thicker than the previous generation.

This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than the previous generation.

However, not all leakers agree—some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's view

Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information to long-standing case manufacturer partners ahead of time, so that third-party cases can launch simultaneously when the new phone goes on sale. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes simply take a gamble based on rumours, and sometimes they get it wrong. Personally, I wouldn't place an order for a case before the new phone is announced.
